sourceInterface.scope: Real source interface in headless Chromium with isolated in-memory native task transport; no live network writes
checks: Delivered package exposes explicit authorization while attachment alone remains unauthorized
Exact map/task/version/hash confirmation can be cancelled without changing authority
Confirmed exact package exposes copy and download actions with durable authorization
Explicit return check stages a valid result while Auto-Sync stays Off; duplicate bytes produce one readable result with both provenances
Untrusted attachment names render as text, with no image/HTML execution or map application
Read-only delivery view reflects authorization uncertainty as Deferred without importing or claiming implementation
Fixed instructions use clipboard or selectable fallback; no model/generation/message call is made
Existing modal layout keeps controls above the footer at 620-pixel window height
Withdrawal removes copy controls, preserves package files and leaves native task fields and queue unchanged
Fixture service initializes with Auto-Sync Off and no network calls
Native package status/manual discovery route works without a linked package and makes no network request
Native manual check rejects a stale renderer map context
Suspend/resume, update quiescence, checkpoint and shutdown drain discovery without network calls or leaked timers

liveYouTrack.scope: Actual read-only returned RDX discovery and durable staging on one private synthetic PMON task
checks: Remembered credential opens only uniquely marked, owner-private QA task destinations
Exact package/context and required assets delivered and authorized on one owner-private marked task
Native reader proved task/project identity and fresh server authorship, then downloaded/validated/retained the exact returned RDX under manual Auto-Sync Off
Closing/reopening the real SQLite store preserves staged bytes and explicit rediscovery creates no duplicate result or map mutation
Task State/assignment/description/priority, managed map head and Auto-Sync Off remained unchanged; discovery made no YouTrack writes, NPCD edits or agent messages
